culture.Overview: A civilisation-state of extraordinary diversity: 22 scheduled languages, every major world religion, and regional cultures that differ as much as countries do.
culture.Traditional clothing: Sari, salwar kameez, lehenga, dhoti, kurta, sherwani, and regional forms such as the Maharashtrian nauvari sari and Kerala's mundu.
culture.Cuisine: Regional cuisines built on spices, rice, wheat and lentils: biryani, dosa and idli, rogan josh, chole bhature, vada pav, dal, and a vast range of sweets.
culture.Festivals: Diwali, Holi, Eid, Christmas, Durga Puja, Ganeshotsav, Onam, Pongal, Navratri, Guru Nanak Jayanti.
culture.Music & dance: Hindustani and Carnatic classical traditions; classical dances including Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Odissi, Kathakali, Kuchipudi, Manipuri, Mohiniyattam and Sattriya.
culture.Sports: Cricket dominates (ICC Men's World Cup 1983, 2011; Men's T20 World Cup 2007, 2024; Women's World Cup 2025). Field hockey: 8 Olympic gold medals. Kabaddi and chess (several world champions) are widely followed.
culture.UNESCO World Heritage: 44 sites (2025), including the Taj Mahal, Ajanta and Ellora caves, Hampi, Western Ghats and the Maratha Military Landscapes.
